original_text: St Johns wort markedly decreases cyclosporin blood concentrations leading to acute organ rejection.
Profound drop of cyclosporin A trough levels after administration of St Johns wort.
St Johns wort decreases plasma concentrations of digoxin by activating intestinal P-glycoprotein.
Spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage during concomitant Ginkgo biloba and warfarin therapy.
American ginseng significantly reduced the peak INR and AUC of total warfarin.
Garlic supplements decrease saquinavir plasma concentrations by roughly 50 percent.
Goldenseal inhibits CYP3A activity in vivo, increasing midazolam exposure.
Curcumin significantly increases systemic tacrolimus exposure in healthy subjects via P-gp/CYP3A inhibition.
Green tea ingestion greatly reduces plasma concentrations of nadolol via OATP1A2 inhibition.
Licorice potentiates corticosteroid activity by inhibiting 11beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2.
Silymarin does not alter indinavir pharmacokinetics in healthy subjects.
Valerian does not alter CYP3A4 mediated disposition of alprazolam in humans.
